description: Source code for HapticGeneratorContext class implementing haptic effect processing in Android audio effects framework.

classes.name: HapticGeneratorContext
classes.description: Implements haptic effect processing, managing filters, parameters, and processing chain for haptic feedback.

methods.name: HapticGeneratorContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing context with sample rate, frame count, and parameters.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the haptic generator effect if initialized.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal filters, slowEnvs, and distortions.

methods.name: setHgHapticScales
methods.description: Sets haptic scales and updates maximum vibrator scale.

methods.name: setHgVibratorInformation
methods.description: Sets vibrator information and updates filter coefficients.

methods.name: lvmProcess
methods.description: Processes audio data to generate haptic feedback.

methods.name: init_params
methods.description: Initializes parameters based on channel layouts.

methods.name: getFloatProperty
methods.description: Gets float property value with default fallback.

methods.name: addBiquadFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to processing chain.

methods.name: buildProcessingChain
methods.description: Constructs the chain of audio processing filters and effects.

methods.name: runProcessingChain
methods.description: Executes the processing chain on input buffers.
